rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9419:details:0: We recently found out that the ⟦E80⟧ has been scavenging the ⟦E3⟧ desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.

rows.quest:9419:details:2: If I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.

rows.quest:9422:obj:0: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with ⟦E81⟧ at the ⟦E80⟧ encampment near Hive'Regal.
rows.quest:9422:details:0: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the ⟦E3⟧ desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.
rows.quest:9422:details:1: But now the ⟦E79⟧ seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.
rows.quest:9422:details:2: I need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
rows.quest:9422:progress:0: Be wary of the dangers of the desert, ⟦49⟧. With the ⟦E79⟧ lurking in the dunes, any step could be your last.
rows.quest:9422:completion:0: You've done well, ⟦50⟧. These resources will be added to our stockpiles, and every bit is to our gain and our enemy's loss.
